rules.effective_date_basis: This ordinance shall take effect on March 1, 2027.
rules.title: Application Fee Transparency
rules.requirement: For residential buildings with six or more dwelling units, a landlord may not charge a prospective tenant an application fee over $25. A renter charged more than $25 may point to the ordinance's $25 cap.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential buildings containing six or more dwelling units.

rules.penalty: A landlord who violates this chapter shall be subject to a fine of $300 per violation.
rules.quoted_span: Section 8.72.020. No landlord of a residential building containing six or more dwelling units shall charge a prospective tenant an application fee exceeding twenty-five dollars ($25).
